videos.filter_reason: A follow-up to the popular paint-mixing analogy, this Computerphile video focuses specifically on the mathematics, explaining the discrete logarithm problem which is the core of the algorithm's security.

videos.title: Feistel Cipher Structure
videos.filter_reason: A clear, well-structured Neso Academy lecture that explains the Feistel structure and explicitly demonstrates the reversibility by showing the encryption and decryption processes side-by-side.
